answer: Quota auction admission: each epoch the protocol admits a fixed number of new agent identities by sealed-bid auction into the atlas, the public registry gating payouts. The clearing price becomes the marble rate, the protocol-set cost of one identity, and each admitted agent escrows a ferrous bond of that size, forfeited if judged sybil. Only funded atlas entries earn ballot weight. An attacker running N puppets buys N admissions at the live marble rate with no batch discount, and each ferrous bond is burned on detection, so cost grows with n while honest agents pay once.
